items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I had a man play for me, and I play his first trumpet with the Philadelphia Symphony.

ctx.x: You know? He just played the wrong instrument. I did the same thing at the Gulfport Institute over there, college over there, military school. The piano was so bad that the saxophones' mouthpiece were falling. I said, shove him in. Don't play the piano. No one knew that he didn't play the piano all night. So then the portable pianist came out. And Russ Papaya bought himself one. And I was about to buy one. But I decided to quit the pianist to get my voice away. And it canceled. She was so sick. So I quit. And so…
